# Antu · Legal Diagrams
中文 | **English**
Antu · Legal Diagrams turns case JSON into one offline HTML diagram—timelines, procedures, relations
hips, and court reasoning—for AI agents and legal professionals. The page is one file of about 2.3 M
B that makes no network request and needs no server; it opens offline and can be archived, printed o
r sent as an attachment. An AI Agent can read the case materials and write the JSON; the engine then
draws the diagram from it, and the same JSON gives the same diagram. Antu is at version 0.x, and th
e formats of the relationship and justification diagrams are still drafts.
## Diagram Types
Four types of legal content, each drawn in several ways. A selector in the page switches between the
ways; nothing in the JSON chooses one.

Relationship
graph
focus view
relation matrix
equity tree

authority chart
related-party list
relation path
Fact
timeline
chronicle
time scale
Procedure
flowch

art
route map
Justification
(experimental)
reasoning tree
Relationship diagrams (seven ways of drawing the same JSON) show parties, roles and legal relationsh

ips; fact diagrams the time, the participants and how events went;
procedure diagrams a procedural p

ath and its branches; justification diagrams a conclusion drawn from norms and facts. The
relationsh
ip and justification schemas are still drafts, and **justification is currently experimental and on
justification schemas are still drafts, and **justification is currently experimental and on hold**.
Four looks, called **themes**: `document` (black and white and square, for print and filing; the def

ault), `modern`
(rounded, pale), `legal` (navy) and `dark` (the modern look on a dark ground, for a

dark host). The reader switches in
the page, or a call fixes a page to one. Only the diagram is them

ed; `dark` also darkens the shell round it. See
spec/theme.md.
## Usage

The page is written beside the JSON file. The interface language of a page is set with `?lang=en` or
`?lang=zh`; the case content is never translated.
## Principle
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Role | Does | Determinism |
| Model | reads documents, extracts facts, understands meaning | the result may differ from run to r

un |
| Engine | draws the diagram according to the specification | the same JSON gives the same diag

ram, whichever model wrote it |
| JSON specification | the only interface between the two | versione
d (see spec/versioning.md) |
The engine does not write JSON, and the Agent does not draw. The model puts information into JSON; t
he engine draws. The JSON specification is a specification of its own, for four reasons:
1. General-purpose charting syntax is built on nodes, edges and state machines, and has no place for

procedural standing or the source of a piece of evidence.
2. The diagram does not depend on which m

odel extracted the information.
3. The same JSON gives the same diagram at any time and in any envir

onment, so a diagram handed to a court or to the other side can be reproduced.
4. The source is reco
rded when the facts are extracted: each fact states the document, the page and the provision it rest
s on, and the diagram shows them. The materials themselves are neither bundled nor linked.
## Agent Integration
The reference material for an Agent, for the fact diagram, is a field table of about 3.4k characters
and a mechanism note of about 6.3k characters.
### Skill

The command line asks the npm registry once a day whether a newer Antu is out (one GET request, noth
ing of any diagram) and, if so, ends its output with a notice. `ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns it
of any diagram) and, if so, ends its output with a notice. `ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns it off.
### MCP
The MCP server is the npm package `@zh-xx/antu`, registered as `io.github.zh-xx/antu` in the MCP reg
P server is the npm package `@zh-xx/antu`, registered as `io.github.zh-xx/antu` in the MCP registry.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Tools: `antu_schema`, `antu_guide`, `antu_examples`, `antu_validate`, `antu_layout`, `antu_render`,
`antu_preview`, `antu_versions`.
### DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
A native DSH plugin, `@zh-xx/antu-dsh` (Host tools + a chat card with a picker of the way of drawing
), is on npm: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zh-xx/antu-dsh`, then restart DSH. It needs DSH 0.2.
0-rc.2 or newer. How it works and how it is tested: docs/dsh/dsh-plugin.md and tools/dsh/README.md.
A profile that cannot use the plugin can still attach `antu-mcp` with a configuration-only bundle; t
he recipe and its limits are in tools/dsh/README.md.

## Documentation
- **Contracts** under `spec/` (what makes a JSON file or API call valid): versioning, themes, paper
size, the MCP server, embedding, source types, and the diagram schemas (fact, procedure, relationshi

p, justification). Agent mechanism notes: `spec/agent/`.
- **Design and reference** under `docs/`: a
rchitecture, layout engines, React Flow features, fact rendering, DSH plugin plan (install notes in

tools/dsh/README.md).
- CHANGELOG.md. Known problems: GitHub issues. Working rules: CONTRIBUTING.md.
## Security
- To report a vulnerability, use the private report described in SECURITY.md; please do not open a p

ublic issue for it.
- Every version of `@zh-xx/antu` and `@zh-xx/antu-dsh` on npm is published by Gi
tHub Actions through npm's trusted publisher, with provenance: the page of the version on npm links
back to the commit and the workflow run that made it. deps.dev shows the same record, with the known

advisories (none at the time of writing) and the licence.
- A page made with Antu works offline and
sends nothing anywhere; the command line asks once a day whether a newer version exists and sends n
othing of a diagram (`ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns that off).
